bug_fixed.issue: Maximum call stack size exceeded during babel compilation
bug_fixed.root_cause: RuleGroup component was recursive (calling itself for nested groups), which caused @emergentbase/visual-edits babel plugin to crash with infinite recursion
bug_fixed.fix: Split into two non-recursive components: SubGroup (for nested groups, depth 1) and RuleGroup (for root level, depth 0). SubGroup does not call RuleGroup, breaking the recursion chain.
